verification.notes: Nick Moody phone self-test, 2026-10-04. Epic copy (GameHub id 160159); the title is also sold on Steam (appid 313690). Verified for menus and intro only. Working path: copy the install with lego_copy.bat (Run program) from the Epic folder to /sdcard/Download/LEGOBatman3 (~8.3 GB duplicate; Epic install was about 8.07–8.67 GB; ask before large copies), then Library → Import → Local Game → LEGOBatman3.exe. Tile "LEGOBatman3" used these defaults: Proton 11.0-arm64x, DXVK 2.6-1-async, Fex_20260913, "Game Presets", Turnip v26.1.0_b8, 1280x720, PulseAudio. Menus/intro 59–60 FPS. Owner: "game runs perfect now". Title, planet, and button icons rendered correctly. Character textures were not re-checked in a cutscene after import. Local import is an offline candidate. Airplane mode was not tested. The old Epic tile still shows Start Extract.
